# ADR-3023: A02: Documented legacy cipher waiver for partner link 11

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Some B2B partners lag on TLS upgrades.

## Decision

Integrations MAY adopt a documented legacy cipher waiver for partner link 11 (A02-11) when a partner cannot upgrade.

## Consequences

Waivers expire and are risk-accepted.
